description: This file defines the ModuleConfig class, which models configuration parameters such as scheme, host, port, URI, environment, and custom configurations for a module in a system.

classes.name: ModuleConfig
classes.description: A Java class representing configuration settings for a module, including scheme, host, port, URI, environment, and additional configurable parameters.

methods.name: getScheme
methods.description: Returns the scheme (e.g., 'http', 'https') used by the module.

methods.name: setScheme
methods.description: Sets the scheme used by the module.

methods.name: getHost
methods.description: Returns the host name or IP address used by the module.

methods.name: setHost
methods.description: Sets the host name or IP address for the module.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Returns the port number used by the module.

methods.name: setPort
methods.description: Sets the port number for the module.

methods.name: getUri
methods.description: Returns the URI path for the module.

methods.name: setUri
methods.description: Sets the URI path for the module.

methods.name: getEnv
methods.description: Returns the environment (e.g., 'development', 'production') for the module.

methods.name: setEnv
methods.description: Sets the environment for the module.
